top_choice_rationale: P001 is a prize for the optical lattice clock to Katori and Ye. Magic-wavelength trapping is a distinct, mechanistically clear idea that differs from the 2005 comb and 2012 ion-control prizes. The 10^-18 many-atom level has been reproduced independently at several laboratories. The two credited roles are separable, Katori for the concept and Ye for the accuracy programme. I judge it mature enough to award now. The citation must stay tied to the lattice concept and its realisation, not to clocks in general. Remaining credit questions about the wider lineage are limits on the wording, not reasons to withhold the prize, so no award ranks below it.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; my PAMELA, Fermi-LAT and XL-Calibur work is astroparticle and gamma-ray physics with no tie to Katori, Ye or atomic clocks
